attributes.name: ypy-stream
attributes.description: Opens a stream of the YPY streaming protocol (Server-Sent Events) with a GET request to the URL and applies its events: `ypy-patch-elements`, `ypy-patch-signals`, `ypy-redirect` and `ypy-event`. Opens on `load` or on the element's `ypy-trigger`; reconnects with backoff, `Last-Event-ID` and the current signals.

attributes.name: ypy-stream.post
attributes.description: Like `ypy-stream`, with a POST request that carries the element's values.

events.name: ypy:stream:open
events.description: A connection delivered its headers and is being read, the first time or after a reconnection.

events.name: ypy:stream:reconnect
events.description: The client is about to wait `detail.delay` ms before the next connection attempt.

events.name: ypy:stream:close
events.description: The stream ended for good. `detail.reason` is `api`, `removed`, `redirect`, `replaced`, `status <code>` or `error`.

events.name: ypy:stream:error
events.description: An event failed, or the read broke; after a read error the client reconnects.

events.name: ypy:stream:signals
events.description: A signals patch arrived and the signals extension is not loaded, so the page can apply it itself.
